conflict: Screenshot prevention against saving the results letter to the photo library

One of the deferred sharing options saves the results letter into the device photo library, where every application can read it. Both cannot be right as they stand: either the letter is an approved export and the screenshot rule is about something narrower, or saving to the gallery is not an acceptable route. Raised from the predecessor application's sharing screens
